description: v2.1.0 section 5.1 — a normalized proposition directly extractable from case text (Call 1 vocabulary). Purely factual: no legal standard, no evaluative judgment.

canonical_meaning.description: Positive truth-condition sentence, e.g. '행위자가 흉기를 사용하였다.' Section 4.2 — canonical positive predicates only, never a negated/absence form.

semantic_exclusions.description: Authored boundary statements distinguishing this factual proposition from adjacent concepts; these statements never provide case truth.

evidence_scope.description: Largest provenance-typed factual carrier for this predicate. Omission means `offense_realization`: the actions Call 1.5 selected for this legal realization (focal action plus its supports), which is what the planner has always supplied and what the measured runs were built on. A predicate that must be judged on one action alone has to say `exact_actor_action` explicitly. `same_actor_episode` widens to every action of the episode the responsibility actor takes part in and never admits a peer actor's conduct. An explicit scope outranks the generic actor-bound GroundFact narrowing. It never authorizes full-case evidence, and participation targets are outside this contract: they carry a typed relation carrier of their own.

semantic_sort.description: 2026-08-08 Step 5 addendum — this atomic predicate's semantic sort (e.g. 'event', 'conduct', 'actor'), drawn from the same growing free-string vocabulary as RelationDef.left_type/right_type and relation_binding.left_view/right_view. Optional: only predicates that actually reach a relation endpoint (directly, or via a PrimitiveDef wrapping them / an ExportedComponentDef exporting them) need one — Step 5 lowering reports 'relation_endpoint_untyped' if such an endpoint lacks it. Unlike an OffenseDef, an atomic predicate DOES have one intrinsic sort, which is exactly why relation-scoped views are needed for the structured kinds but not here.

type.description: entity = actor/object/event-typed argument (v1's 'variable' kind renamed for clarity); string/boolean unchanged from v1's rule_ir.schema.json $defs.argument.kind.
